job.title: Construction Plant Fitter / Plant Inspector
job.description:
Teamforce Labour are currently seeking an experienced Construction Plant Fitter / Plant Inspector to join the team on the prestigious Lower Thames Crossing project in East Tilbury, Essex.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced, hands-on Plant Fitter to work on one of the UK's largest infrastructure projects.
The role will primarily involve carrying out plant inspections, hired equipment pre-use checks and general plant maintenance, ensuring construction plant and equipment is safe, serviceable and fit for use.
This is a hands-on fitter position and not a supervisory or management role.
We are looking for an experienced, practical fitter with a strong understanding of construction plant who is confident identifying mechanical defects through thorough physical and operational inspection.

Key Responsibilities
  • Carrying out thorough inspections of construction plant and equipment.
  • Completing pre-use and acceptance inspections on hired plant and equipment before it is put into service.
  • Checking plant for mechanical defects, damage, leaks, excessive wear and other potential safety or maintenance issues.
  • Inspecting a variety of construction and earthmoving plant and associated equipment.
  • Carrying out preventative and routine maintenance.
  • Undertaking corrective maintenance and minor repairs where required.
  • Diagnosing mechanical, hydraulic and diesel engine faults.
  • Inspecting pumps, compressors and associated mechanical equipment.
  • Ensuring plant and machinery is safe, serviceable and suitable for its intended use.
  • Accurately recording inspections, defects and maintenance activities using digital reporting systems.
  • Escalating defects or equipment concerns where further repair or specialist attention is required.
  • Working closely with site teams while maintaining an independent and impartial approach to the inspection of hired plant.
  • Ensuring all activities are carried out in accordance with site health, safety and environmental requirements.

Essential Requirements, candidates should have:
  • Proven experience as a Construction Plant Fitter, Plant Mechanic, Plant Inspector or similar hands-on mechanical role.
  • Strong practical experience working with construction and earthmoving plant.
  • Good working knowledge of diesel engines, hydraulic systems, pumps, compressors and associated mechanical equipment.
  • Hands-on experience carrying out plant servicing, preventative maintenance and corrective maintenance.
  • Strong fault-finding and defect identification skills.
  • Experience conducting plant inspections and pre-use/serviceability checks.
  • Ability to confidently determine whether plant and equipment is safe and fit for use.
  • Previous experience using digital inspection or maintenance reporting systems such as GMAO/CMMS, Dalux, equipment inspection software or similar platforms.
  • Ability to accurately complete and maintain digital inspection and maintenance records.
  • Strong awareness of construction site health and safety requirements.
  • An up-to-date CV demonstrating relevant plant fitting and maintenance experience.

The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for a traditional, hands-on Plant Fitter with excellent practical knowledge of construction machinery.
The successful candidate should be comfortable inspecting machinery using their mechanical knowledge and experience – identifying issues through visual inspection, operational checks, sound, vibration, smell, feel and overall machine condition.
This position does not require a supervisor, manager or senior mechanic. The focus is on finding an experienced and reliable fitter who can carry out high-quality plant inspections and maintenance on site.
Candidates must also be able to carry out inspections impartially and without any conflict of interest with plant hire suppliers.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work on the Lower Thames Crossing, one of the UK's most significant infrastructure projects.
